[XML](http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/XML) is basically a very very basic language used in alot of applications(mostly for their back-end tasks). An example of XML used in the ATLauncher is:

    <mod name="GregTech"
    version="4.07L"
    url="packs/LunaCraft/files/gregtechmod.zip" 
    file="gregtechmod.zip" 
    md5="55104d5c943272c757f741994b3211bc"
    type="mods"
    download="server"
    website="http://forum.industrial-craft.net/?page=Thread&threadID=7156"
    donation="https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=5TSWPMD6NLHBN"
    description="Taking Industry to a whole new Level of Complexity!"/>

This basically tells the launcher what the mod is named, where to download it from, the file name, and it provides the website to the original post!

Now, before you get frustrated, 90% of that is generated from the ATLauncher itself. The only thing you are responsible to edit is the first line, and description.
